user.notes: OTP request is gated by Google reCAPTCHA v3 (is_captcha_enabled true for every client, Verified) and refresh needs the PWA's client secret. SuperYar never solves or bypasses a captcha, so the user logs in on snapp.market's own page inside SuperYar and SuperYar copies localStorage JWT. Live HAR 2026-10-30: loginMobileWithNoPass sends the reCAPTCHA token with the phone; loginMobileWithToken answers oauth2_token {access_token, refresh_token, expires_in 3600}, so the copied session lasts about 1 hour.

compliance.notes: ToS unreadable (redirect loop). No permission. The PWA's public params client/deviceType/appVersion are omitted (Q-SM-3); all endpoints answered without them on 2026-10-30. Guest OAuth flow not used. User-account operations (engine 2) act only on the user's own carts, never checkout or payment.

unsupported.collectionProducts: SnappMarket's home sections and product lists (/express-home/mobile/v3/user/new-home, /express-home/vendor/{code}) return 401 (code 3004) anonymously (verified 2026-10-30). The web client gets its token with the embedded OAuth client secret, which ARD 04 §4 forbids. Home shows SnappMarket through SuperYar's own discount rails instead.
